_doc: Frozen GNU Make VPATH evidence configuration for REL_16_11 (plan step 1). Every make_evidence.py subcommand reads this file; nothing here may change inside one evidence cycle. Reasons for every disabled optional feature and for the builddir location are in evidence/environment.md.
external_roots_note: builddir, prefix and evidence_out live on the native btrfs root filesystem (/home/redstar/pg-builds), never on the OrbStack virtiofs mount (/Users). srcdir stays on virtiofs and is only read.

migration.reason: virtiofs (/Users) is not POSIX enough for the test suite: (1) readdir() on a mode-0400 directory fails with EACCES instead of stat() of its entries failing, so pg_verifybackup/t/003_corruption.pl subtest 44 (search_directory_fails) cannot match 'could not stat file or directory'; (2) a file written by one process (walreceiver) was read back as zeros by another (startup) at the same offset repeatedly, so recovery/t/032_relfilenode_reuse.pl timed out waiting for catchup in one of two runs ('invalid magic number 0000 in WAL segment 000000010000000000000003, LSN 0/3764000, offset 7749632').
migration.old_evidence_kept_at: /Users/niejinbo/work/code/pg/postgres.builds/REL_16_11_base-evidence (diagnostic archive, not part of the baseline)

disabled_features.--with-tcl: no tcl-devel: /usr/include/tcl.h and tclConfig.sh absent (only runtime tcl-8.6.12 installed)
disabled_features.--with-zstd: no zstd-devel: /usr/include/zstd.h absent (only runtime libzstd.so.1.5.0 installed)
disabled_features.--with-llvm: no llvm-devel: llvm-config absent (only llvm-libs-12.0.1 runtime and clang-12 installed)
disabled_features.--with-bonjour: macOS-only API, not applicable on Linux
disabled_features.--with-bsd-auth: BSD-only API, not applicable on Linux
disabled_features.--with-uuid=ossp: mutually exclusive with --with-uuid=e2fs; e2fs (util-linux libuuid 2.37.2) chosen
disabled_features.--with-system-tzdata: not used; the bundled src/timezone build is part of the baseline
disabled_features.--with-llvm bitcode (.bc): depends on --with-llvm; no bitcode objects exist in this baseline

env_unset_note: The build and test environment is created with env -i; LC_ALL, LANGUAGE, TZ, TMPDIR, PGPORT, PGHOST, PGDATA, PG_TEST_EXTRA, PROVE_FLAGS, MAKEFLAGS, CFLAGS, CPPFLAGS, LDFLAGS and PKG_CONFIG_PATH are intentionally absent.

capture_targets.name: check_prereqs
capture_targets.note: compile the test programs/modules that check-world would otherwise build in parallel (src/test/regress, isolation, modules); needed for .o/.Po/argv closure

capture_targets.name: check_prereqs_ecpg
capture_targets.note: ecpg test programs (generated TUs in builddir)

capture_targets.name: check_prereqs_pg_bsd_indent
capture_targets.note: pg_bsd_indent is built only by its own TAP check (not by world-bin); its 7 objects would otherwise be compiled in parallel by check-world

check_world._doc: -k so every suite runs even after a failure (the failure set must be complete, not whatever make happened to start before the first error); -Orecurse groups each recursive make's output so the '# +++ ... check in DIR +++' anchors are attributable.
